将静止图像变成视频

在 Floyo 上打开这个可立即运行的工作流程。无需安装。

它是如何运作的

步骤 1. 上传起始帧剪辑开始的图像。具有移动空间的清晰主体可以提供最干净的动作。适用于：照片·插图·产品照片·人物艺术

步骤 2. 添加结束框架（可选）上传第二张图像以设置剪辑的放置位置。该模型以动画形式呈现从起始帧到结束帧的运动。将其保留，让运动从起始图像中自由运行。

步骤 3. 写一个简短的动作提示描述什么应该移动以及如何移动，例如“当她转向灯光时，相机慢慢推入”。保持具体。

步骤 4. 点击运行并下载您将获得流畅的 480p MP4。工作流程会插入额外的帧，以便清晰地播放运动。准备就绪：Premiere · CapCut · DaVinci Resolve · 任何编辑器

第一次？将所有设置保留原样。默认值（480p·6 个步骤·固定种子）对于几乎每个人来说都是正确的起点。

概述

此工作流程使用 Wan 2.2 14B（阿里巴巴 Wan 团队的开放权重模型）将静态图像转换为短视频。 Wan 2.2 采用混合专家设计，将设置运动的高噪声专家与锐化细节的低噪声专家配对，这就是为什么它的运动比大多数开放视频模型更好地结合在一起。可选的结束帧可让您设置剪辑的着陆位置，以便您可以构建受控的过渡或干净的循环。您上传一个开始帧，编写一个简短的动作提示，然后在大约一分钟内获得流畅的 480p MP4。无需设置，无需繁重的本地 GPU，无需连接节点。

这是给谁的：想要在 ComfyUI 中使用 Wan 2.2 图像到视频管道而无需从头开始组装节点的创作者。不适用于：零调整的一键结果。您仍然可以选择开始帧、提示和设置。

为什么选择弗洛约

Floyo 是浏览器中唯一为团队构建的 ComfyUI 平台。

  • 专为团队打造。在整个团队中共享运行历史记录、文件和模型。队友会打开您的确切路线并从您上次停下的地方继续。没有文件交接，没有版本混乱。

  • 无需安装，无需设置。每个工作流程和模型均已预加载。在浏览器中打开它并运行。无需下载，无需配置。

  • 没有本地硬件。工作流程在 H100 NVL GPU 上运行，因此重型模型无需您自己的卡即可快速运行。您的 VRAM 不再是限制。

  • 在一处打开和关闭模型。Floyo 同时运行开源工作流程和 API 模型。

如何使用（在 Floyo 上的浏览器中）

  1. 上传您的起始帧。添加可选的结束帧以设置剪辑的着陆位置。

  2. 编写一个简短的动作提示，然后使用默认种子以 480p 运行快速测试。

  3. 从运行中下载 MP4，为任何编辑器做好准备。

期望
模型已预加载，因此无需下载任何内容。运行它需要一个免费的 Floyo 帐户。更大的帧数和更高的分辨率需要更多的时间，并且最终帧剪辑比单帧剪辑更重。

使用案例

社交和短片使用您描述的动作将单个图像动画化为 Reels、Shorts 或 TikTok 的剪辑。

转换和循环设置开始帧和结束帧以在两个图像之间构建受控过渡，或循环回到开始位置的剪辑。

艺术家和插画家在风格保持不变的情况下，通过微妙、受控的动作将人物艺术或绘画带入生活。

产品与营销将产品静态图片变成登陆页面或社交帖子的短片。

o.en:
Turn a still image into video

Open this ready-to-run workflow on Floyo. No install needed.

HOW IT WORKS

Step 1. Upload a start frameThe image your clip begins on. A clear subject with room to move gives the cleanest motion.Works great with: photos · illustrations · product shots · character art

Step 2. Add an end frame (optional)Upload a second image to set where the clip lands. The model animates the motion from the start frame to the end frame. Leave it out to let the motion run free from the start image.

Step 3. Write a short motion promptDescribe what should move and how, like "the camera pushes in slowly as she turns toward the light." Keep it concrete.

Step 4. Hit run and downloadYou get back a smooth 480p MP4. The workflow interpolates extra frames so the motion plays back cleanly.Ready for: Premiere · CapCut · DaVinci Resolve · any editor

First time?Leave every setting as-is. The defaults (480p · 6 steps · fixed seed) are the right starting point for almost everyone.

Overview

This workflow turns a still image into a short video using Wan 2.2 14B, an open-weight model from Alibaba's Wan team. Wan 2.2 uses a Mixture-of-Experts design, pairing a high-noise expert that sets the motion with a low-noise expert that sharpens the detail, which is why its motion holds together better than most open video models. An optional end frame lets you set where the clip lands, so you can build a controlled transition or a clean loop. You upload a start frame, write a short motion prompt, and get back a smooth 480p MP4 in about a minute. No setup, no heavy local GPU, no nodes to wire.

Who it's for: creators who want the Wan 2.2 image-to-video pipeline in ComfyUI without assembling the nodes from scratch. Not for: one-click results with zero tuning. You still choose the start frame, the prompt, and the settings.

Why Floyo

Floyo is the only ComfyUI platform built for teams in the browser.

  • Made for teams.Share run history, files, and models across your whole team. A teammate opens your exact run and picks up where you left off. No file handoffs, no version confusion.

  • No install, no setup.Every workflow and model is preloaded. Open it in your browser and run. Nothing to download, nothing to configure.

  • No local hardware.Workflows run on H100 NVL GPUs, so heavy models run fast without a card of your own. Your VRAM stops being the limit.

  • Open and closed models in one place.Floyo runs open-source workflows and API models side by side.

How to use (in your browser on Floyo)

  1. Upload your start frame. Add an optional end frame to set where the clip lands.

  2. Write a short motion prompt, then run a quick test at 480p with the default seed.

  3. Download the MP4 from the run, ready for any editor.

Expectations
The models are preloaded, so there is nothing to download. Running it needs a free Floyo account. Bigger frame counts and higher resolutions take more time, and end-frame clips are heavier than single-frame ones.

Use Cases

Social & Short-formAnimate a single image into a clip for Reels, Shorts, or TikTok, with the motion you describe.

Transitions & LoopsSet a start and an end frame to build a controlled transition between two images, or a clip that loops back to where it began.

Artists & IllustratorsBring character art or a painting to life with subtle, controlled motion while the style holds.

Product & MarketingTurn a product still into a short motion piece for a landing page or a social post.
